name: Taste Skill
summary: Portable agent skills that upgrade AI-built interfaces: layout, typography, motion and spacing rules plus image-generation skills.
description: Portable agent skills that upgrade AI-built interfaces: stronger layout, typography, motion and spacing instead of boilerplate-looking UIs. The default design-taste-frontend skill (v2, experimental) reads the brief, infers a design language and exposes VARIANCE / MOTION / DENSITY dials; other skills cover GPT/Codex variants, image-to-code pipelines, redesign audits, soft, minimalist and brutalist directions, plus output enforcement. Three image-generation skills produce website comps, mobile screens and brand kits. Installs with npx skills add; framework agnostic; MIT.
